title: How Four Teen Girls Got Busted After Stealing Dad’s Car
description:
On January 20th, 2023, officers responded to a car theft. One of the witnesses told the police that juveniles had used a crowbar to break in and steal the car. The other officer attempted to collect fingerprints from the cup. Shortly after, another team of officers, who were following the stolen vehicle based on the description provided by dispatch, attempted to investigate it. Soon, the owner of the vehicle arrived to get his car. Meanwhile, the other officers were interrogating the two girls. The officer tried to explain the situation to the juvenile suspect. One of the officers attempted to contact the foster parent of the suspect's friend. The other two girls were not released to their parents; instead, they were taken to juvenile centers. Meanwhile, the officer and the juvenile worker attempted to reason with the other female. Denise was charged with runaway, while Maria was charged with unlawful taking of a motor vehicle. Additionally, Irissa was charged with possession of marijuana and resisting arrest.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
